contents.text: CarbonX Cone with an overmolded ART Surround
3 1" Magnets stacked between two CNC'd aluminum top plates
Two piece cast aluminum basket assembly serves as a housing to support the differential drive
Serves as the housing for the molded isolation components and has a locator pin to position in the cabinet
Rubber insert serves as an alternative insert as opposed to a carpet spike and adds an additional layer of isolation
Molded insert is press fit into the foot housing and isolates the floor from the top of the foot
This layer isolates the foot from the cabinet for an additional layer of isolation from the floor
The foot inserts add an additional layer of isolation to the feet, ensuring even the screws are unable to transfer vibrations from the cabinet to the feet
Woven Spiders paired for stability and 35mm excursion in both directions
Ventilated Nomex former with dual layer copper coils
The vertical braces on the interior of the cabinet serve to give the cabinet its faceted exterior and also provide for a unified, rigid housing to maintain the force generated by the woofer.
Woofer is fastened into the front panel
One Piece cast aluminum amp panel houses the amp components powering the subwoofer
Haptic touch volume controls that sync directly with your mobile app, so their is no calibration issues between traditional physical dials and your digital control app
Two 2500W AMP boards powering the XR
